title: How To Upload Products On Sendbox Business Platform
body_markdown:
Now that you have joined Sendbox for Business platform, what is next? It is simple, start uploading your products and sharing your store page link on your social media pages and websites. Uploading your products and getting the link to your store page is as simple as ABC.


#### In this post, we will cover:


1. How to upload products on our business platform
2. How to get your store page link


**How to upload products (web platform)**


Step 1: Log in to your Sendbox business account on sendbox.co/business


Step 2: From the blue sidebar, click on ‘’products’’ (bottom left)


Step 3: Click on the ‘’add product’’ icon on the product page


Step 4: Input all the required details needed on the *create product* page


Step 5: Once completed, click on ‘’create product’’ (located at the bottom of the page)


**How to upload products (**[mobile platform](https://www.instagram.com/p/CDlVjTOlphZ/) **)**


Step 1: Log in to your Sendbox business account on sendbox.co/business


Step 2: Tap on the three lines icon (hamburger button) on the top right of business dashboard


Step 3: From the blue sidebar, click on ‘’products’’ (bottom left)


Step 4: Click on the ‘’add product’’ icon on the product page


Step 5: Input all the required details needed on the *create product* page


Step 6: Once completed, click on ‘’create product’’ (located at the bottom of the page)


**How to get store page link (web platform)**


Step 1: Log in to your Sendbox business account on sendbox.co/business


Step 2: From the blue sidebar, click on ‘’products’’ (bottom left)


Step 3: Click on the ‘’view my store’’ icon on the product page


Step 4: Copy the link your store page on the search tab


**How to get store page link (mobile platform)**


Step 1: Log in to your Sendbox business account on sendbox.co/business


Step 3: Click on the ‘’view my store’’ icon on the product page


Step 4: Copy the link your store page on the search tab
